headline: Fed held rates Oct 28; two dissents favored a hike
body: The FOMC held the target range at 3.75%–4.00% on 2026-10-28 by a 10–2 vote; two governors preferred a 1/4-point increase. With the 10-Yr Treasury near 5%, non-debt capital (TNECD SDG, EDA, USDA) matters more for rural industrial park readiness.

headline: TVA data center rate took effect Oct 1
body: TVA's board approved a rate for large data center loads averaging about a 10% increase, phased over three years, effective 2026-10-01. TVA projects load of 9 to 33 GW by 2040 (WFAE, 2026-08-25).

headline: September revenues beat budget by $335.9M
body: Tennessee collected $2.5B in September 2026, $335.9M over estimate and $331.9M over September 2025 (15.09% growth). Franchise & excise taxes ran $311.1M over estimate on a jump in quarterly estimated payments; sales tax ran $36.1M over. Year to date, collections are $390.5M above estimate (TN F&A, released 2026-10-16).

headline: TN unemployment held at 3.4% in September
body: Seasonally adjusted, unchanged for a third month and 0.1 pp below a year ago; U.S. 4.2%. TN added 28,400 nonfarm jobs over the year and 2,500 over the month (TDLWD, 2026-10-15).

headline: Three SMTN towns win Downtown Improvement Grants
body: TNECD awarded 14 grants totaling $3,900,568 on 2026-10-28. SMTN: Centerville $300,000, Collinwood $125,000, Mount Pleasant $325,000. 25% match required.

headline: Marshall County selected for a housing market analysis
body: TNECD and Points Consulting will analyze housing needs in 14 counties, including Marshall, the only SMTN county selected (TNECD, 2026-10-27).
